entities.summary: Ömeriye Mosque, is a mosque in the walled city of Nicosia on the island of Cyprus, located in the south section of Nicosia. Following the Turkish invasion of Cyprus, the mosque gained significance as one of the most important sites of Muslim worship in the non-Muslim section of the island and the city.
